purpose: Teach: 谷口/柳沢/奥田/新井/荒木/浅野/村山/大田

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、指導教授の谷口先生のご研究を継承しろ
lines.en: Ren — inherit your advisor Professor Taniguchi's research direction.
lines.style: Measured authority. Clear assignment of purpose, not question. Deliberate pace. The weight of expectation delivered as straightforward instruction, not demand.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。柳沢教授の論文を読み込みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read through Professor Yanagisawa's papers thoroughly.
lines.style: Earnest affirmation. Slight lift on the opening. Quick internal pivot to specificity — he's already thinking about execution. Respectful but grounded, not performatively formal.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究の奥田先生に研究照会しろ
lines.en: Ren — contact Professor Okuda about the collaborative research inquiry.
lines.style: Steady, procedural. Each instruction lands with equal weight. No inflection that softens or emphasizes. The voice of someone accustomed to being followed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会で新井助教のご発表を聴きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll listen to Assistant Professor Arai's presentation at the conference.
lines.style: Quick nod in the voice. Eager without being breathless. Each task already filed away mentally. The enthusiasm of someone young enough to still find direction energizing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、文献の荒木先生のご論文も参考にしろ
lines.en: Ren — also reference Professor Araki's work in the literature review.
lines.style: Slight pause before 'also' — adding to a growing list. Tone unchanged: this is how information is conveyed. Not hurried, not leisurely. Expectation of compliance implicit.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の浅野先輩からご指導を仰ぎます
lines.en: Yes. I'll ask for guidance from Asano, my senior in the lab.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment with a subtle shift — invoking hierarchy properly, checking internal box. Quieter on the ending. The formality of deference without hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外連携の村山教授と打ち合わせしろ
lines.en: Ren — coordinate with Professor Murayama on the international partnership.
lines.style: Final instruction carries slight emphasis on scope. 'International' lands with deliberateness. Still composed but the stakes have shifted upward slightly in the delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の窓口、大田事務官に申請します
lines.en: Yes. I'll submit the application through Ota in the graduate office.
lines.style: Closing affirmation with quiet resolution. Slight exhale after 'yes' — the last piece, the practical anchor. Steady hand tying off the thread. Respectfully final without sounding dismissive.
